citations.narrative:
The licensee transported two adult dogs across state lines without obtaining a health certificate executed and issued by a
licensed veterinarian prior to transport. Health certificates help ensure that such animals are healthy, fit for travel and
appear free of any infectious disease or other physical abnormality that could endanger the animal, public health, or other
animals. The health certificate shall state that the licensed veterinarian inspected the dogs on a specified date which shall
not be more than 10 days prior to transportation. All dogs that are transported in commerce (exhibition) must be
accompanied by a health certificate. A licensed veterinarian must examine the animals and complete a health certificate.
To be corrected by: 6/29/26
This inspection was conducted at the Sturgis Falls Celebration in Cedar Falls, Iowa.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
Additional Inspectors:
Paige Johnson, ANIMAL CARE INSPECTOR n
